a2_contact_semantics.finding: A2 did not state whether remaining capacity in the contact where proof becomes ready counts as the withheld opportunity.
a2_contact_semantics.repair: the contact in which transition proof first becomes ready is the single withheld eligible contact; proof bytes cannot use its remaining capacity

p3_terminal_overlap.finding: the generic insufficient-transfer predicate and the specific P3 guard-block predicate can overlap.
p3_terminal_overlap.repair: when the P3 guard actively blocks commit, CONTACT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is the specific terminal classification; otherwise generic incomplete pre-commit transfer may classify as INSUFFICIENT_MATERIAL_TRANSFER

policy_alias_endpoint.claim_boundary: logical slot-index separation only; not empirical exposure time, operational risk, or latency
policy_alias_endpoint.definition: for P2 only, max(0, min(commit_slot_or_deadline, deadline) - proof_accepted_slot); zero when proof is not accepted or for non-P2 policies
policy_alias_endpoint.finding: P1_STAGED_CUTOVER and P2_HYBRID_OVERLAP were observationally aliased under the Phase-8.0 endpoint set because successor pre-commit acceptance was not measured.
policy_alias_endpoint.repair: add dual_epoch_overlap_slots as a secondary modeled policy-state endpoint

truncated_schedule_multiplicity.finding: R1 phase offsets 1/4 and 2/5 produce identical pre-deadline contact-slot sets at D12 and D24 even though their full 48-slot schedules are distinct.
truncated_schedule_multiplicity.repair: retain all six equally weighted phase-factor positions; record the multiplicity explicitly and do not claim all deadline-truncated schedules are unique
